name: live-layer-protocol
description: Live Layer Protocol: stream signed WebAssembly layers into a running app, no CI/CD

scripts.test: node test/run.mjs && node test/security.mjs && node test/sandbox.mjs && node test/service.mjs && node test/live-e2e.mjs && node test/ai-loop.mjs && node test/fleet.mjs && node test/hosts.mjs && node case-studies/run.mjs --no-write
scripts.build: asc layers/tasks-as/app.ts -o build/tasks.wasm -O3 && clang --target=wasm32 -nostdlib -O2 -Wl,--no-entry -o build/stats.wasm layers/stats-c/stats.c && asc layers/variants/tasks_v2.ts -o build/tasks_v2.wasm -O3 && asc layers/variants/tasks_broken.ts -o build/tasks_broken.wasm -O3 && asc layers/variants/tasks_trap.ts -o build/tasks_trap.wasm -O3 && asc layers/variants/tasks_hang.ts -o build/tasks_hang.wasm -O3 && asc layers/variants/tasks_hang_migrate.ts -o build/tasks_hang_migrate.wasm -O3 && for f in tasks_shared tasks_shared_v2; do asc layers/variants/$f.ts -o build/$f.wasm -O3; done && for f in tasks_sync tasks_sync_v2 pay bad; do asc layers/server/$f.ts -o build/$f.wasm -O3; done && for f in cs_sensor cs_sensor_291 kn_smars_old kn_smars_rlp cf_waf cf_waf_bad fa_edge_v1 fa_edge_v2 hf_game_v1 hf_game_v2; do asc case-studies/layers/$f.ts -o build/$f.wasm -O3; done
